summary: This directory provides foundational network communication capabilities, enabling the application to perform HTTP requests, process data streams, and handle formatted responses such as JSON and XML for external service integration.
responsibilities: Executing HTTP requests using various methods and configurations
Managing web data streams for network operations
Parsing and serializing JSON and XML response formats
Facilitating file downloads from remote resources
relationships: The web client leverages network effects to perform requests and convert raw byte streams into structured data.
Data parsers transform raw text or byte streams retrieved from web requests into structured JSON or XML objects.
Download utilities utilize the web client to fetch and persist remote content to local storage.
designDecisions: Use of Effect pattern for declarative error handling and network operations
Abstraction of fetch operations to support proxies and streaming
Consistent response container types for typed data handling
Modular decomposition of data format processing into distinct modules
